features: Monitor output intended for system setup and service/troubleshooting, not continuous live view
Up to 54TB storage (3 x 18TB), hot-swappable removable bays
USB: front 1 x USB 2.0, rear 4 x USB 3.0; 1 x RS-232
Preloaded VIGIL VMS (v7.5 and above); Windows 11 IoT LTSC (24H2)
Supported video codecs: MJPEG, MPEG-4, H.264, H.264+, H.265
IP PTZ support; multi-streaming support; IP audio support
Recording modes: motion, alarm, audio, analytics; audio OggVorbis 16 Kbps
Edge-based analytics: people counting, tripwire, loitering alarms
Third-party integrations: access control, alarm, ATM, POS, time/attendance
notes: Max MP support: 2026 datasheet gives 480MP; 2022 NVR-2U-16CH/24CH Hybrid Series spec sheet gives 64MP.
CPU: 2026 datasheet product table gives Gen 10 Intel Core i5, its specifications give Gen 10 Intel Celeron; 2022 spec sheet gives Celeron.
OS: 2022 spec sheet gives Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2019.

USB: 2026 datasheet gives 1 front USB 2.0 and 4 rear USB 3.0, and its key features list a front USB 3.0 port; 2022 spec sheet gives "1 Front USB 2.0; 6 Rear - 4x USB3.0". Total USB port count left out.
2026 datasheet title mentions alarm I/O but gives no input or output count.
